items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: So anyway so his wife Ann said, “Okay Longineu I’m going to make him do it, I’m going to make him do it.”

ctx.x: Yeah. So anyway so his wife Ann said, “Okay Longineu I’m going to make him do it, I’m going to make him do it.” So a couple of months later I’m on a gig in Orlando, in comes Nat Adderley holding his horn case. Now all before Nat had been telling me, you know, you don’t come and sit in on my gigs ‘cause you ain’t going to make no reputation on me [mumbles]. All out of love, you know, fun. So here he is coming up to me, “Hey man, can I sit in?” “What?” “Yeah.” “What is this?” So he came and pulled out his horn and…
Aw, bless your heart. I didn’t know any of that.
